title: Human pathogens (bacterial, fungal, protozoan; illustrative starter list)
description: Organisms with recognised human pathogenic potential. Many are also commensals or environmental organisms; pathogenicity is often strain-level (virulence genes, serotype), which taxonomic classification alone cannot establish. Hazard group per UK ACDP Approved List as understood at time of writing; verify against the current list before relying on it.

entries.name: Listeria monocytogenes
entries.notes: Key foodborne pathogen; persistent in food manufacturing environments (drains, wet areas).

entries.name: Salmonella enterica
entries.notes: Serovars Typhi/Paratyphi are HG3; serovar cannot be determined from taxonomy alone.

entries.name: Escherichia coli
entries.notes: Mostly commensal; STEC/VTEC (e.g. O157) are HG3. Needs virulence-gene evidence (stx, eae).

entries.name: Shigella
entries.notes: Genus. S. dysenteriae type 1 is HG3. Very hard to separate from E. coli by sequence classification.

entries.name: Staphylococcus aureus
entries.notes: Enterotoxin producer; also skin/nasal commensal - common from human handling.

entries.name: Bacillus cereus
entries.notes: B. cereus group members (incl. B. anthracis, B. thuringiensis) are hard to separate.

entries.name: Bacillus anthracis
entries.notes: Usually a misassignment within the B. cereus group; confirm with specific markers before raising concern.

entries.name: Clostridium botulinum
entries.notes: Polyphyletic species; botulinum toxin genes are the relevant evidence.

entries.name: Yersinia enterocolitica
entries.notes: Psychrotrophic; grows at refrigeration temperatures.

entries.name: Yersinia pestis
entries.notes: Near-identical to Y. pseudotuberculosis; treat assignments with great caution.

entries.name: Vibrio cholerae
entries.notes: Toxigenic O1/O139 status requires ctx genes.

entries.name: Vibrio parahaemolyticus
entries.notes: Seafood-associated.

entries.name: Vibrio vulnificus
entries.notes: Seafood-associated.

entries.name: Cronobacter sakazakii
entries.notes: Powdered infant formula risk.

entries.name: Klebsiella pneumoniae
entries.notes: Important AMR carrier.

entries.name: Enterococcus faecium
entries.notes: Also a faecal indicator.

entries.name: Enterococcus faecalis
entries.notes: Also a faecal indicator.

entries.name: Legionella pneumophila
entries.notes: Relevant to water systems, cooling towers.

entries.name: Brucella
entries.notes: Genus.

entries.name: Candidozyma auris
entries.notes: Formerly Candida auris; name in your taxonomy may differ.
